ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous zones on lateral lobes. Large, irregular low-intensity black mottling concentrated at the axial base. Scattered circular black focal spots (5-15 pixels in diameter) distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration map consisting of multiple peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge; frequency of approximately 12-15 distinct peaks per lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve leading to tapered, upward-swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular high-contrast pixel groups concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes (barnacle colonization). Smaller circular dark spots scattered throughout the white high-intensity zones.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the mid-left lobe and lower-right lobe, representing surface rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified clusters on the distal tips creating a jagged, non-biological profile expansion beyond the dermal boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique diagonal alignment of circular dark spots on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
